description: Compares two or three listings from search_listings side by side: price, price per square meter, estimated purchase costs, area, rooms, building, energy certificate, features and agent. Only stored data; missing information is "unbekannt". Returns a link to the same comparison on objelio.de, where the user can save the listings and contact the agents.

listing_ids.description: Two or three ids from search_listings.

name: compare_listings

nicht_verfuegbar.description: Ids that are no longer published.

objekte.description: The compared listings, in the order of the columns.

demo.description: true = demo listing with invented data.

link.description: Listing page on objelio.de, where the user contacts the agent.

vergleich_link.description: The same comparison on objelio.de. Show it to the user.

zeilen.description: Comparison rows. Only stored data; price per m² is calculated, purchase costs are estimated.

beste.description: Column indexes (0-based) with the best value of the row, e.g. lowest price; empty if not comparable.

geschaetzt.description: true = estimate (purchase costs), not given by the agent.

name.description: Row name in German, e.g. Preis, Wohnfläche, Energiekennwert.

werte.description: One value per listing; "unbekannt" = no information, "entfällt" = does not apply to this property type.

title: Compare listings
